blocks.caption: Chapter 7 key terms
rows: Hypothesis
A testable statement about a population, situation or relationship between variables
Hypothesis testing
A statistical method for deciding whether sample data gives enough evidence to support or reject a claim
Null hypothesis (H0)
There is no significant difference, effect or relationship
Alternative hypothesis (H1 or Ha)
There is a significant difference, effect or relationship
Test statistic
A number from sample data used to decide, such as z, t or F
Critical region
The part of the distribution where H0 is rejected
Significance level (alpha)
The largest probability of rejecting H0 when it is true; commonly 0.05
p-value
The probability of the observed or a more extreme result if H0 is true
Decision rule
The rule for rejecting or not rejecting H0, e.g. reject if p-value < alpha
Data visualisation
Graphs, charts and diagrams that present data and support interpretation
Bias
An unfair influence on collection, analysis or interpretation that misleads
Ethical use of data
Collecting, analysing and reporting honestly, fairly and responsibly while protecting privacy
Communicating results
Presenting findings clearly and accurately, related to the original hypothesis
